text_block_list.text:
When I visited the trainer's room before 
training, Satono Diamond had already 
arrived. She seemed to be reading 
something, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Written words truly carry the feelings 
of the person who wrote them, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, a fan letter was delivered for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The letters radiate such strong emotion... 
I can't help reading it over and over 
again.
choice_data_list: May I ask what it's about?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Apparently, the business they started 
failed, and dark clouds gathered over 
their life at one point.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Her feelings of guilt toward her family 
grew, and she spent days on end not 
knowing what to do, or so she said.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"However, one day, they happened to see 
one of my races on TV—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They said my strong resolve "to break the 
jinx" gave them courage.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And right now, while working another job, 
they haven't given up on their dream and 
are gradually developing ideas for their 
next venture.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...The handwriting wavers at times, grows 
firm at others, but at the very end, the 
name is clearly signed."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure this person has made up their 
mind and is striving to carve out their 
own path, just as I am."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if my comrade is doing her best, 
then I certainly cannot afford to drag my 
feet either.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us dedicate ourselves to training 
today. To forge a brand-new path!
